overview: After 1.d4 d5 2.e4 dxe4 White plays 3.Be3 instead of 3.Nc3. White aims for Qd2, Nc3, O-O-O and a quick kingside attack with h4 and Bd3, offering the e4 pawn while keeping flexible. Black can keep the extra pawn and develop with ...Nf6 and ...e6. Engines favour Black, but the attack is easy to play.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Nc3, Qd2 and castle long, then push h4
Aim the bishop on d3 at h7 and the queen at the king

black_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn and develop with ...Nf6, ...e6 and ...Be7
Trade pieces to blunt the attack

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White ahead in development
Black pawn on e4 or exchanged, open d-file

character.notes: Gambit attack with long castling and a kingside pawn storm.

gambit.notes: White gives the e4 pawn and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: White's compensation is insufficient at engine level.
